articles.headline: Inside Commanders DC Daronte Jones' unusual coaching journey
articles.description: From living in his car to various college offices, Washington defensive coordinator Daronte Jones has paid his dues.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 1 [1296x729]
images.caption: Jones, who is in his first season as an NFL defensive coordinator, is charged with turning around the Commanders' defense, which was one of the worst in the NFL last season.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 2 [1296x1296]
images.caption: Jones' nearly 3-foot-long Albino Burmese Python, Goldie Gambino, accompanied him throughout his early coaching journey.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 4 [1296x729]
images.caption: Jones slept in his 1988 Honda Prelude for two months while coaching at Chicago's North Park University.

images.name: Daronte Jones photo 5 [1296x864]
images.caption: Jones spent one season at UCLA as a grad assistant.

images.name: Daronte Jones is no stranger to adversity
